entries.name: Improved Tactical Mastery

desc.1: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 5 Rage when you change stances.
desc.2: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 10 Rage when you change stances.
desc.3: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Improved Tactical Mastery changed to a 3-point talent, 5/10/15 Rage (was 5 points of 3)

desc.1: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 2%.
desc.2: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 4%.
desc.3: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

entries.name: Bloodthrill

desc.1: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 10% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.
desc.2: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 20% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Bloodthrill changed to a 2-point talent, 10/20% (was 5 points of 4%)

entries.name: Improved Slam

desc.1: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.25 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 2.5 sec.
desc.2: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 5.0 sec.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Improved Slam's reduction to Slam's cooldown changed to 2.5/5 seconds (was 3.0/3.0)

entries.name: Enrage
entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Enrage moved to Row 3 (was Row 4). Column guessed: 4, the free square in row 3

talent.name: Reckless Swings
talent.cost: 25% of base health; Instant; 15 sec cooldown

desc.1: Your next 4 melee attacks generate 5 additional Rage. Lasts 8 sec.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): New Talent: Reckless Swings. Row 4. 1 Point. 15 second cooldown. Costs 25% of base health. Column guessed: 3, Enrage's old square; icon a placeholder

entries.name: Gore Drinker
entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Gore Drinker moved to Row 5 (was Row 6) and is connected to Blood Craze now instead of Enrage. Column guessed: 3, under Blood Craze

entries.name: Flurry

desc.1: Increases your melee attack speed by 10% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
desc.2: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
desc.3: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Death Wish is no longer required for Flurry. Flurry changed to a 3-point talent, 10/20/30% (was 5 points of 5%)

desc.1: Reduces the cooldown of your Whirlwind ability by 1 sec and increases the damage it deals to the closest enemy by 15%.
desc.2: Reduces the cooldown of your Whirlwind ability by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals to the closest enemy by 30%.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): New Talent: Improved Whirlwind. Row 6. 2 Point. Passive. Column guessed: 3, Gore Drinker's old square

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Bloodthirst now has Death Wish as a required talent
